Poly-sinc: Poly-sinc extended response: Blackman-Harris window, lower side lobes.

Poly-sinc: Half-band: the half-band family from the manual.

Poly-sinc: Long sinc: the S / M / MG / L / LL tiers grow step by step.

多相 sinc: 闭式插值：Blackman-Harris 窗，旁瓣最低。
Poly-sinc: Closed-form: Blackman-Harris window, lowest side lobes.

Poly-sinc: Minimum ringing: listed as a special type in the manual.

多相 sinc: 切趾：通带高频平滑滚降，压低预振铃。
Poly-sinc: Apodizing: smooth roll-off at the high end of the passband, reducing pre-ringing.

多相 sinc: 线性相位：冲激响应对称，峰值前后都有振铃。
Poly-sinc: Linear phase: symmetric impulse response, ringing both before and after the peak.

多相 sinc: 最小相位：无前振铃，能量集中在脉冲起始处。
Poly-sinc: Minimum phase: no pre-ringing, energy concentrated at the start of the impulse.

多相 sinc: 混合相位：幅频不变，群延迟落在最小与线性之间。
Poly-sinc: Intermediate phase: same magnitude response, group delay between minimum and linear.
